name: Lacustrine-Carn

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a tidally locked hemisphere, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Signal chatter rises from the inhabited zones, structured, rhythmic, and unmistakably deliberate.
Whoever abandoned the derelict space station in orbit did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
